verdict.rationale: Forter provides several background automations that run without manual intervention — real-time webhooks for chargeback/claim forwarding (forter-docs-8/14/26), automated evidence recommendation and submission (forter-docs-10/15/16), and auto-invoice/capture logic (forter-docs-18) — plus an MCP interface letting an AI agent trigger actions like managing disputes (forter-docs-9/20). However, these are largely fixed system behaviors or webhook subscriptions rather than a user-configurable automation/workflow builder that an AI-native user 'sets up' to run autonomously. Missing for 10: an explicit automation/rule-builder UI or API for users to define custom autonomous workflows, and independent evidence that MCP-triggered agent actions run unattended in the background over time.
